source_text: Frostfell was not always one kingdom. It was split in two, the North and the South. In the North, the non magical kingdom. To the South, a kingdom full of fantastical displays of power. Due to the North’s greed, the two kingdoms clashed in a never ending war, until the South offered a truce.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: 0430 Ítalskt tími. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var hans ábyrgð að vekja alla aðra í fyrirtækinu sínu. Hann fór ósýnilega úr rúminu sínu, klæddist bardagafötum sínum, setti á sig árásarvestið sitt og pakkaði sínum eignum úr skápnum sínum, en var varkár með sérstaka litla kassa. Hann bar riffilinn sinn og setti hettuna sína á litla hengi sem tengdist belti hans. Það hafði allt sem þurfti, andlitsgrímur, gleraugu, allt sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa skoðað skotfærin sín, fór hann rólega út úr herberginu, með mýri og ís undir skónum sínum.

He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: Klukkan 0430 að Itania-tíma. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var hans ábyrgð að vekja alla hina í fyrirtækinu. Hann stígur hljóðlega út úr rúminu, klæddist bardagafötunum, kastaði yfir sig árásarvestinu og pakkadi saman eigur sínar úr skápnum, sérstaklega varlegur með einn litinn kassa. Hann setti byssuna yfir öxlina og festi hjálminn á litinn krók sem tengdist belti hans. Allt var á honum, andgríman, gleraugun, allt sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa athugað skotfærahylkina, gekk hann hljóðlega út úr hermannakofanum, leir og ís skvettu undan stígvélunum.

source_text: He took a lighter from his jacket pocket and a cig from the other. Lighting it, he took a small drag before opening the door slightly. Over the last week he had to get creative when waking the men and women under his command. He stopped using the preset wake up alarm, half the time it never worked, when all that came from the speakers was a light hiss.

Undanfarin viku hafði hann þurft að finna upp nýjar leiðir til að vekja mennina og konurnar undir sér. source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: 0430 Ítalíutími. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var hans ábyrgð að vekja aðra í fyrirtækinu. Hann gekk hljóðlega út úr herberginu sínu og klæddi sig í bardagabúninginn, setti á sig skotvopnsvestið og pakkaði eigum sínum úr skápnum, gaf sér góðan tíma með sérstaka litla kassa. Hann bar riffilinn sinn og setti hjálm sinn á lítinn krók sem var tengdur við beltið. Það hafði allt sitt festingar, andlitsgrímu, gleraugu, allt sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa athugað skammbyssupokana sína gekk hann hljóðlega út úr herbúðunum, drullu og ís skvamlaði undir skónum hans.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: 0430 að ítölskum tíma. Cohren þoldi ekki að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var á hans ábyrgð að vekja alla aðra í fyrirtækinu sínu. Hljóðlega steig hann út úr koju sinni, klæddi sig í bardagafötin, kastaði á árásarvestið sitt og pakkaði saman eigum sínum úr skápnum sínum og fór varlega með tiltekinn lítinn kassa. source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: 04.30 að ítölskum tíma. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var á hans ábyrgð að vekja alla aðra í herfylkinu. Hann steig hljóðlega úr kojunni, klæddi sig í hermannafötin, setti á sig hjálminn og pakkaði niður eigum sínum úr skápnum, passaði sig að fara varlega með litla kassa. Hann hengdi riffilinn yfir axlirnar og setti hjálminn á lítið krók sem var festur við beltið. Á honum var allur búnaðurinn, öndunargríman, hlífðargleraugun, allt sem til þurfti. Eftir að hafa athugað skotfærapokana, fór hann hljóðlega út úr herstöðinni, þar sem drulla og ís kraumaði undir skónum hans.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: Klukkan 0430 að Itania-tíma. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var hans ábyrgð að vekja alla hina í fyrirtækinu. Hann stígur hljóðlega út úr rúminu, klæddist bardagafötunum, kastaði yfir sig árásarvestinu og pakkadi saman eigur sínar úr skápnum, sérstaklega varlegur með einn litinn kassa. Hann setti byssuna yfir öxlina og festi hjálminn á litinn krók sem tengdist belti hans. Allt var á honum, andgríman, gleraugun, allt sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa athugað skotfærahylkina, gekk hann hljóðlega út úr hermannakofanum, leir og ís skvettu undan stígvélunum.

source_text: 0430 Itania time. Cohren hated waking up this early. Mainly because it was his responsibility to wake everyone else up in his company. Silently stepping out of his bunk, he put on his combat fatigues, throwing on his assault vest, and packed up his belongings from his locker, being careful with a particular small box. He shoulded his rifle and put his helmet on a small hook connected to his belt. It had all its fixing, respirator, goggles, everything needed. After checking his ammo pouches, he quietly walked out of the barracks, mud and ice squelching under his boots.
input_text: Klukkan 04:30 að Itania tíma. Cohren hataði að vakna svona snemma. Aðallega vegna þess að það var á hans ábyrgð að vekja alla aðra í herdeildinni sinni. Hann steig hljóðlega út úr kojunni, klæddist bardagabúningnum, fór í árásarvestið og pakkaði saman eigum sínum úr skápnum, og gætti sérstaklega að litlum kassa. Hann hengdi riffilinn á öxlina og festi hjálminn á krók á beltinu. Hann var með öllum fylgihlutum, öndunargrímunni, hlífðargleraugunum, öllu sem þurfti. Eftir að hafa athugað skotfæravasana gekk hann hljóðlega út úr herberginu, leðja og ís slettist undir stígvélunum.
